sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: I have docked below at Interactive Lab 1: the Dawid-Skene EM Likelihood Ascent and Mutual-Information Quality Studio! Toggle between the EM Rescue, Skewed Moderation Queue, and Collusion Ring presets above to observe how seven iterations of log-likelihood ascent rescue sixty-two point five percent majority consensus up to one hundred percent ground truth, while Ipeirotis mutual information strips Always-0 spammers down to zero!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Look at those dual canvases directly above! Under ninety-ten skew, that Always-0 click-bot earns ninety percent raw accuracy yet collapses to zero bits of mutual information, while our systematic flipper gets inverted into high-value signal!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: I have docked below at Interactive Lab 2: the Living Wage, Worker Reputation Cliff, and Toxic Exposure Studio! Switch between the Responsible Charter, Exploitative RLHF Harm, and Mass Rejection Cliff presets above to examine how five hundred unjust rejections push a four-thousand-task veteran off the ninety-eight percent approval cliff, and verify our three-pillar ethical scorecard!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Watch that reputation curve on the left canvas plunge right through the red dashed ninety-eight percent qualification floor! That is why responsible engineering teams approve ambiguous batches and enforce two-hour clinical shift caps!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 1! Examine the mathematical conditions under which Dawid-Skene Expectation-Maximization ascends the marginal log-likelihood to resolve disputed majority ties, versus when gold anchors are required to break class-permutation symmetry.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Checkpoint time, Dr. Nova! In our eight-item benchmark, Worker 2 flipped their labels, dragging naive majority vote down to sixty-two point five percent. Why did seven iterations of EM fix that disputed tie completely?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Spot on! Because initial majority voting positively aligns on five of eight items, Expectation-Maximization ascends the marginal log-likelihood monotonically from negative seventeen point one three to negative ten point six three, inverting Worker 2's confusion matrix to one hundred percent truth—while gold anchors break permutation symmetry!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Remember that EM doesn't discard workers—it estimates confusion matrices! When initial majority voting has positive correlation, log-likelihood ascent locks the true class orientation; only purely symmetric fifty-fifty cohorts require gold sentinel anchors to resolve label switching.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 2! Calculate the lifetime approval rating after five hundred unjust batch rejections on a four-thousand-task veteran rater, and identify the platform qualification consequence.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Let's check the numbers on Slide 11! A veteran rater completed four thousand tasks at ninety-nine percent approval. What happens to their account standing if an inexperienced requester mass-rejects a batch of five hundred ambiguous labels?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Correct! The post-batch approval rate drops sharply to thirty-nine sixty over forty-five hundred, or exactly eighty-eight point zero percent! Because commercial qualification gates require at least ninety-eight percent lifetime approval, that single mass rejection permanently locks out a veteran annotator!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Use the formula: approved tasks equal thirty-nine sixty divided by total tasks of forty-five hundred, which yields exactly eighty-eight point zero percent! This drops the worker far below the platform's ninety-eight percent qualification threshold, barring them from future queues.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 3! Compare raw classification accuracy against information-theoretic Ipeirotis mutual information for an Always-Majority click-bot versus a Systematic Flipper under severe class skew.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Final checkpoint, Dr. Nova! In a content moderation queue with ninety percent benign posts, why is rewarding workers based purely on raw accuracy an architectural disaster?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Outstanding mastery! Under ninety-ten skew, raw accuracy severely misleads: an Always-0 click-bot gets ninety percent accuracy with zero mutual information, while a systematic flipper with ten percent accuracy carries zero point four five zero one bits of invertible mutual information!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Under class imbalance, an Always-0 spammer gets ninety percent accuracy by sheer prior probability, but conditional entropy equals prior entropy so q w collapses to zero! Conversely, the flipper's confusion matrix is informative and yields q w equal to zero point four five zero one.
